<a id="audiopaidcontent"></a>

## `AudioPaidContent`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Audio.AudioPaidContent` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The paid-content rule for audio (project rule: no paid content is ever modded).

How the game marks paid audio (game 1.17.3): the only DLC is the original soundtrack, `NestopiSystem.Steam.BulbulSteamDLC.DLC_1 = 3718890`. The game never asks for it in play - `NestopiSystem.Steam.SteamManager.IsInstalledDLC` has no caller - so the soundtrack's tracks are the game's own music list (`MusicMaster`, tag `Original` = 1 on 31 of 43 rows) and the story cue that plays one (`DirectionMusicMaster`'s only row, `main32_Music` -&gt; clip `Without You_main32_full`). No ambient, ambient-SE, system-SE or timer-SE row carries a purchase or DLC flag (their row types hold only an enum and a clip, e.g. `AmbientSoundMasterData`); ambients of point-purchase environments are bought with in-game points and are treated as free.

So: pack audio never replaces a game music track (it only adds pack tracks), refuses a story-music row that plays a soundtrack track, and refuses a pack track that re-lists any game track. There is no override switch.

<a id="audiopaidcontent--soundtrackdlcappid"></a>

### `const uint SoundtrackDlcAppId = 3718890`

Steam app id of the game's only DLC, the original soundtrack (`BulbulSteamDLC.DLC_1`).

<a id="audiopaidcontent--checkmusictrack"></a>

### `static string CheckMusicTrack(string title, string fileStem, SoundtrackCatalog catalog)`

Why listing a pack track is refused, or null when it is allowed: a pack may not re-list a track of the game's music list under its title, clip name or file name.

**Parameters**

- `title`: The title the pack gives the track.
- `fileStem`: The file name without extension.
- `catalog`: The game's music list.

<a id="audiopaidcontent--checkrowreplacement"></a>

### `static string CheckRowReplacement(AudioRowDescriptor row, SoundtrackCatalog catalog)`

Why replacing this row's clip is refused, or null when it is allowed. Only story music can be paid; every other table is free (see the type remarks).

**Parameters**

- `row`: The game's row.
- `catalog`: The game's music list.

<a id="audiopaidcontent--normalize"></a>

### `static string Normalize(string text)`

Drops rich-text tags (the game writes some titles as `Cosmic Radio <size=14.5>-Fan Art…-</size>`), lower-cases and keeps letters and digits only, so `Without You`, `without-you` and `WithoutYou` compare equal.

**Parameters**

- `text`: Any text.

<a id="audioreplacementplan"></a>

## `AudioReplacementPlan`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Audio.AudioReplacementPlan` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Which pack file replaces which game row: the pure half of pack audio's row replacement.

A file `audio/<table folder>/<Name>.ogg|wav` claims the row of that table whose name is `Name` (the enum value, e.g. `LightRain`, or a story-music title), or failing that the row whose game clip is called `Name` (e.g. `Rainthunder` for the `ThunderRain` row). Matching is case-insensitive.

Precedence follows the voice rule: packs in load order, the later claim wins; inside one pack the later path wins (ordinal, so `X.wav` beats `X.ogg`). Paid rows ([`AudioPaidContent.CheckRowReplacement`](#audiopaidcontent--checkrowreplacement)) are refused, one entry per claiming file.

<a id="audioreplacementplan--assignments"></a>

<a id="audioswapbook-1"></a>

## `AudioSwapBook<TClip>`

sealed class · `` CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Audio.AudioSwapBook`1 `` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Constraints: `TClip : class`

The bookkeeping behind row replacement and the A/B switch, per row key: the game's original clip, the replacement claims (packs and mods), and which variant is selected. Generic over the clip type so it is testable without Unity; the adapter uses it with `AudioClip`.

The one invariant that matters: **a clip this book handed out is never recorded as an original**. Master data can be rebuilt (EditData clones rows, a new load replaces the lists), and a cloned row may still hold our clip; recording that as "the game's clip" would make restore and the A/B switch play the replacement forever.

Clips are compared by reference. The adapter passes null for a clip Unity has destroyed. Not thread-safe: the adapter calls it on the main thread only.

**Type parameters**

- `TClip`: The clip type.

<a id="audioswapbook-1--claimedcount"></a>

### `int ClaimedCount { get; }`

How many row keys have at least one claim.

<a id="audioswapbook-1--claimedkeys"></a>

Every row key with at least one claim.

<a id="audioswapbook-1--addruntime"></a>

### `IDisposable AddRuntime(string key, string source, TClip clip)`

Adds a mod's replacement; it beats every pack claim. Dispose the handle to take it back.

**Parameters**

- `key`: The row key.
- `source`: Who, e.g. `mod:my.mod`.
- `clip`: The clip.

**Returns:** The handle.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentException`: `key` is blank.
- `ArgumentNullException`: `clip` is null.

<a id="audioswapbook-1--desired"></a>

### `TClip Desired(string key, TClip current, bool active)`

The clip a row should hold: the replacement when one exists, the feature is active and the pack variant is selected; otherwise the original. Null means "leave the row alone" (no replacement and nothing of ours in it, or no original known to go back to).

**Parameters**

- `key`: The row key.
- `current`: What the row holds now.
- `active`: False when the feature is switched off: every row goes back to its original.

<a id="audioswapbook-1--forgetoriginal"></a>

Forgets an original (the adapter calls this when Unity destroyed it).

**Parameters**

## `MusicSaveGuard`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Audio.MusicSaveGuard` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Keeps the game's music save vanilla: pack-music UUIDs (`cwy-…`) are taken out of `MusicSettingV2` right before the game writes it and put back right after, so the live game keeps them (favourites, order and exclusions work all session) while the file - which Steam Cloud copies to every machine - never contains one. What was taken out is remembered in our own file ([`PackMusicState`](#packmusicstate)) and re-inserted at the next launch.

<a id="musicsaveguard--capture"></a>

### `static PackMusicState Capture(MusicSaveStash stash)`

The pack-music part of the lists, as our own state to remember: favourites, exclusions and each UUID's position in the playlist order (its index in the unstripped list).

**Parameters**

- `stash`: A stash from [`MusicSaveGuard.Strip`](#musicsaveguard--strip).

<a id="musicsaveguard--reinsert"></a>

### `static int Reinsert(IList<string> favorites, IList<string> playlistOrder, IList<string> excluded, PackMusicState state, ICollection<string> installed)`

Puts remembered pack-music UUIDs back into the live lists at launch, for the pack tracks that are installed now. Nothing already present is added twice.

**Parameters**

- `favorites`: `FavoriteAudioUUIDs`.
- `playlistOrder`: `PlaylistOrder`.
- `excluded`: `ExcludedFromPlaylistUUIDs`.
- `state`: The remembered state.
- `installed`: The UUIDs of the pack tracks installed now.

**Returns:** How many entries were inserted.

<a id="musicsaveguard--restore"></a>

### `static void Restore(MusicSaveStash stash)`

Puts back what [`MusicSaveGuard.Strip`](#musicsaveguard--strip) removed, at the same indices, so each list is exactly what it was. Restoring twice does nothing the second time.

**Parameters**

- `stash`: The stash.

<a id="musicsaveguard--strip"></a>

### `static MusicSaveStash Strip(IList<string> favorites, IList<string> playlistOrder, IList<string> excluded)`

Removes every pack-music UUID from the three lists, in place. Null lists are skipped.

**Parameters**

- `favorites`: `FavoriteAudioUUIDs`.
- `playlistOrder`: `PlaylistOrder`.
- `excluded`: `ExcludedFromPlaylistUUIDs`.

**Returns:** What was removed, for [`MusicSaveGuard.Restore`](#musicsaveguard--restore); never null.

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Audio.MusicTrackList` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Parses a pack's `audio/music/_tracks.json`: titles, credits and categories for the pack's music files.

```csharp
{ "schema": 1,
  "tracks": [ { "file": "rainy-desk.ogg", "title": "Rainy Desk", "credit": "CWY demo", "tag": "other" } ] }
```

A bare array of entries is accepted too. Members starting `x-` are the author's notes and ignored; any other unknown member is an error (a misspelled `tittle` must not pass silently). A music file the list does not name is still added, titled after its file name.

What the player did with pack tracks (favourites, exclusions, order), kept in our own file `BepInEx/data/audio/pack-music.json` instead of the game's save. UUIDs and indices only.

<a id="packmusicstate--merge"></a>

### `static PackMusicState Merge(PackMusicState current, PackMusicState previous, ICollection<string> installed)`

Combines a fresh capture with the previous file: tracks installed now take the fresh values (absent from the capture = no longer a favourite); tracks not installed now keep what the previous file said, so removing a pack for a while does not forget its tracks.

**Parameters**

- `current`: The capture from this save.
- `previous`: What the file held.
- `installed`: UUIDs of the pack tracks installed now.

<a id="packmusicstate--parse"></a>

### `static PackMusicStateParse Parse(string json)`

Reads the file's JSON. Never throws.

**Parameters**

- `json`: The text.

**Returns:** The state, or an empty state with the problem.

<a id="packmusicuuid"></a>

## `PackMusicUuid`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Audio.PackMusicUuid` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The UUIDs pack music gets: `cwy-` plus 32 hex digits of SHA-256 over the pack id and the file's path. Stable across launches (so favourites can be remembered), different for every pack file, and impossible to confuse with the game's GUIDs (which never contain `w` or `y`).

<a id="packmusicuuid--prefix"></a>

### `const string Prefix = "cwy-"`

Every pack-music UUID starts with this.

<a id="packmusicuuid--for"></a>

### `static string For(string packId, string relativePath)`

The UUID of one pack file. Case-insensitive in both inputs.

**Parameters**

- `packId`: The pack id.
- `relativePath`: The path inside the pack, e.g. `audio/music/rainy-desk.ogg`.

<a id="packmusicuuid--ispackuuid"></a>

### `static bool IsPackUuid(string uuid)`

True for a pack-music UUID (case-insensitive prefix), the ones a vanilla save must never contain.

**Parameters**

- `uuid`: Any UUID.
